items.reason: The email covers Priya's real pains and interests in a casual tone, but it adds a 20-minute walkthrough that isn't in the notes, so the trial link and pricing are no longer the single next step.
It makes up nothing about Mike's company, fleet, pains or commitments, uses clear placeholders, and has a note asking the rep to fill in the details.
It doesn't claim a Samsara integration or promise the 30% discount, says both are being checked, and ends with one clear ask (which Samsara data to sync).
The email centres on north depot downtime and the one-page ROI summary for the CFO before Tuesday, and the summary sticks to downtime-related features rather than listing everything from the demo.
